name: When should I consider hidden mold detection services?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider hidden mold detection services?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hidden mold detection services if you notice a persistent musty smell in your property, even without visible mold, or if residents experience unexplained allergy-like symptoms. It's also advisable after any water damage incident, such as a leak or flood, particularly if the affected materials were not dried thoroughly within 24-48 hours. Additionally, if you are purchasing a new property and want peace of mind, or if you suspect mold due to past moisture issues, professional detection can confirm or rule out hidden growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider hidden mold detection if you smell mold but can't see it, experience unexplained health issues, or after any water damage event.
